name: Studio DAW
description: Text-based music production: songs are YAML (instruments, note/chord/grid patterns, arrangement, mix with effects and automation) rendered to WAV/MP3/MIDI with a spectrogram preview and a loudness report. Plays built-in synths, samples, SoundFont presets and pack instruments; imports MIDI files; makes one-shot sound effects for games; extensible with Python plugins. Users can open the same songs in the website's visual DAW (edits are written back into the YAML).
